title: Kimi stands in for an unavailable Claude reviewer, as for Codex
outcome: Kimi stands in for an unavailable Claude reviewer, as for Codex
acceptance: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md remain byte-identical and, together with .claude/commands/review-changes.md, docs/agent-pair-workflow.md and docs/development.md, permit at most one Kimi stand-in per review round for a Codex or Claude reviewer unavailable due to a recorded usage limit or outage, preserving two independent reviewers of different vendors and all other landing conditions.

The review command's frontmatter, admission, spawn-failure and missing-submission guidance consistently apply that same single-stand-in rule to either vendor, without changing design-explorer fallback or optional third-review policy.

completion.summary: Kimi may replace either unavailable counted reviewer, at most once per round, with the other vendor and all landing safeguards preserved.
